description: Implementation of ManufacturerService for managing manufacturer entities, including CRUD operations, listing, and description management within a Spring-based e-commerce application.

classes.name: ManufacturerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing manufacturer management operations, extending generic entity service, annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a manufacturer entity after retrieving it by ID.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with a specific store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products in specific categories within a store.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a manufacturer, initializing descriptions set if null.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a manufacturer entity based on its ID.
